# Evaluation providers
Source: https://docs.genguardx.ai/integrations/evaluation-providers/
Markdown: https://docs.genguardx.ai/integrations/evaluation-providers/index.md
Description: Connect external evaluation and guardrail providers such as Cleanlab, MedBAR, and Guardrails AI to GGX.

Evaluation providers add external trust, safety, and quality signals to GGX assessments and judges. Connect them in **Org Settings → Integrations → Judges**.

| Integration | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [Cleanlab](https://docs.genguardx.ai/integrations/evaluation-providers/cleanlab/) | Trustworthiness scores and data quality checks for agents, RAG, and datasets. |
| [MedBAR](https://docs.genguardx.ai/integrations/evaluation-providers/medbar/) | Question plans and medical evaluations. |
| [Guardrails AI](https://docs.genguardx.ai/integrations/evaluation-providers/guardrails-ai/) | Input and output guardrails for LLM applications. |
